reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin focused on presenting interactive fiction through narrative panels, selectable options, floating story-state information, and related persistence and agent features.

summaries.zh: 通过叙事面板、选项按钮和悬浮信息层，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供带章节进度保存的互动小说体验。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with an interactive-fiction experience using narrative panels, selectable story options, floating state information, and chapter progress persistence.

capabilities: Embeds interactive-fiction narrative content in a UI panel
Provides selectable story options as buttons
Displays persistent character, scene, and item information in a floating layer
Uses a sub-agent to generate narrative text
